turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My friends invited me on a hike but the forecast says rain in the afternoon.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Tricky. You could start very early and be down before the rain, or move the hike to another day. What do you think?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you hang on? I have to talk to someone here. I'll tell you when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hannah, do you know the wifi password here? My phone keeps dropping off.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's on the back of the router, I think. The long one with all the letters.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ugh, I typed that in twice already.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Did you try forgetting the network and joining again? That fixed mine last week.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, I'll try that now. Hold on.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm back, sorry for the wait.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi again. Any decision on the rainy hike?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let's go early. Everyone's already free that day.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then aim to be on the trail by seven, and still pack a rain jacket just in case.
